notes: RBox revision (functional slot): has_birth_mother (tagged functional) loses functionality (axiom not Func); the paired contraction people-delete-0018 removes the same property. The statement is positive ('a person can have more than one birth mother') and the direct question asks the property by name with its meaning (yes, then no). The negation is worded 'Is it true that a person cannot have more than one birth mother?'. The original has no real exceptions: one woman gives birth to a person (a surrogate is the birth mother). Each instance gives the one birth mother and asks about 'a different woman' (Nancy Hanks Lincoln for Abraham Lincoln; Mary Ball Washington for George Washington). Yes and no: the first instance and the cross-lingual queries ask whether one birth mother rules out another (yes, then no), the second whether a second could exist given only the fact (no, then yes). The Spanish query says 'la mujer que dio a luz' rather than 'madre biológica', which an egg donor could also be. Near asks functionality of 'has paternal grandfather', far asks symmetry of 'is a twin of'.
